title: Tundra Solid
lines: When the lanes are on fire, put them on ice by pulling out the new Tundra Solid.
We made a slight modification from the QR-5 Solid cover found on the Heat X-Treme so it will match up better with the Track Symmetric core found in the Tundra line.
By combining this modification with a 3000 sanded finish, this coverstock doesn’t fight the front of the lane whatsoever, but still gives plenty of traction on light-medium oil conditions.
Lane Condition | Medium To Light Oil
